body:
### About Me.
I am a student who is studying Computer Science at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. I am really passionate about programming and I really like solving problems through code. Right now, I am searching for technical internships to gain experience in the industry and build a great foundation for the later work that I do.

### Projects
Kumi - Allows users to send distress signals (via phone call, text, email) to friends and family when they are in danger with a press of a button on a BLE (bluetooth low energy) device.

Tweets2News - Web app that allows users to find articles based on tweets. 

### Technical Skills
Javascript, Python, Java, Ruby, SQL, React.JS/Redux, Node.JS, Flask, Sencha Touch, Cordova.JS
